questions.question: X and Y together can complete a piece of work in 20 days, while Y and Z together can complete it in 24 days. After X worked on it for 10 days and Y for 18 days, Z alone completed the remaining work in another 13 days. X and Z together can complete 75% of the original in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

X and Y together can complete the work = 20 days

Y and Z together can complete the work = 24 days

**Formula used:**

W = E × T Where, W = Work, E = Efficiency, and T = Time

**Calculation:**

Let the X, Y, and Z can complete the work in X, Y, and Z days respectively

One day work of X = {1over X}

One day work of Y = {1over Y}

One day work of Z = {1over Z}

According to the question

⇒ {1over X} + {1over Y} = {1over 20} ----(1)

⇒ {1over Y} + {1over Z} = {1over 24} ----(2)

⇒ {10over X} + {18over Y} + {13over Z} = {1} ----(3)

From equations (2) and (3)

⇒ ({1 - {10over X} - {18over Y}}) times {1over 13} = {{1over 24} - {1over Y}}

⇒ {(1 - {10over X} - {18over Y})} = {{13over 24} - {13over Y}}

⇒ {1 - {13over 24}} = {5over Y} + {10over X}

⇒ {11over 24} = {5over Y} + {10over X} ----(4)

By solving the equation (1) and (4)

The value of X, Y, and Z = 24, 120, and 30 respectively

The X and Z together can complete the 75% of the work in D days

⇒ {Dover 24} + {Dover30} = {3over 4}

⇒ D = 10 days

**∴ The required result will be 10 days.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Calculation:

According to the question,

X = 10 days

Y = 10 + 8 days

Z = 8 + 5 days

X + Y in 10 days do 10/20 = 1/2 the work

Y + Z in 8 days do 8/24 = 1/3 of the work

Work remaining = 1 - 1/2 - 1/3 = 1/6 of the work

This is done by Z in 5 days

So Z alone = 30 days

Let Y alone take y days,

⇒ 1/y + 1/30 = 1/24

⇒ 1/y = 1/24 – 1/30 = 6/720 = 1/120

So Y alone = 120 days

Let X alone take x days

⇒ 1/x + 1/120 = 1/20

⇒ 1/x = 1/20 - 1/120 = 5/120 = 1/24

So X alone = 24 days

X + Z in 1 day = 1/24 +1/30 = 54/720 = 3/40

So, X + Z take 40/3 days to do the complete work

75% of work will take them = 40/3 × 75/100 = 10 days

 

∴ X and Z together can complete 75% of the original in 10 days.

if a - 1/a = b

⇒ 8x3 - 1/x3 = 27 + 6 × 3

⇒ 8x3 - 1/x3 = 27 + 18

⇒ 8x3 - 1/x3 = 45

By multiplying both sides with x³ we get,

8x⁶ - 1 = 45x³

Now,

By subtracting both side by 25x³ we get,

8x6 - 25x3 - 1 = 45x³ - 25x³

⇒ 20x³

questions.question: The 6-digit number 439xy5 is divisible by 125. How many such 6-digit numbers are there?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For divisibility by 125, the last 3 digits of the number must be exactly divisible by 125.

The given number 439xy5 ends with the digit 5.

The 3-digit multiples of 125 that end in 5 are 125, 375, 625, and 875.

This gives exactly 4 possible valid combinations for the digits x and y.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 numbers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The 6-digit number is 439xy5.

The number is perfectly divisible by 125.

**Concept Used:**

A number is divisible by 125 if the number formed by its last three digits is a multiple of 125.

**Calculations:**

⇒ The last three digits of the given number are xy5.

⇒ We need to find all 3-digit multiples of 125.

⇒ The multiples of 125 up to 1000 are: 125, 250, 375, 500, 625, 750, and 875.

⇒ Since the last digit of our specific number is 5, we must eliminate all multiples ending in 0 (which are 250, 500, and 750).

⇒ The remaining possible values for xy5 are 125, 375, 625, and 875.

⇒ This corresponds to 4 different values for the digit pair (x, y).

**∴ The correct answer is 4 numbers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 25

A number is divisible by 25 if its last two digits are 00, 25, 50, or 75.

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is exactly divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 125

A number is divisible by 125 if the number formed by its last three digits is a multiple of 125 (e.g., 000, 125, 250, 375, etc.).

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 7,410 is divided between A, B and C such that the ratio of the share of A to the combined share of B and C is 9 ∶ 17 and the ratio of the share of C to the combined share of A and B is 5 ∶ 8. What is the ratio of the shares of B and C?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum = Rs. 7410

**Calculation:**

Let the share of A, B, and C be A, B, and C respectively

According to question

⇒ {Aover B + C} = {9over 17}

⇒ 17A = 9B + 9C ----(1)

⇒ {Cover A + B} = {5over 8}

⇒ 8C = 5A + 5B ----(2)

From equation (1) and (2)

⇒ 136A = 72B + 45A + 45B

⇒ 136A - 45A = 72B + 45B

⇒ 91A = 117B

⇒ 7A = 9B ----(3)

By equation (1)

⇒ 17A = 7A + 9C

⇒ 10A = 9C ----(4)

⇒ A + B + C = 7410

⇒ A + {7Aover 9} + {10Aover 9} = 7410

⇒ 9A + 7A + 10A = 9 × 7410

⇒ 26A = 66690

⇒ A = 2565

The share of B = {7Aover 9} = {7 times 2565over 9} = 1995

The share of C = 7410 - 2565 - 1995 = 2850

The ratio of B and C = {1995over 2850} = {7over 10}

**∴ The required result will be 7 : 10.**

questions.question: The average weight of some boys in a group is 45 kg. If 10 boys with an average weight of 39 kg join the group or 10 boys with an average weight of 49 kg leave the group, then the average weight of boys in both cases is equal. How many boys were there in the group initially?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average weight of the boys = 45 kg

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/No. of elements

**Calculation:**

Let total number of boys be x

So, total weight of them = 45x kg

According to the question,

(45x + 390)/(x + 10) = (45x - 490)/(x - 10)

⇒ 45x² - 450x + 390x - 3900 = 45x² - 490x + 450x - 4900

⇒ - 60x - 3900 = - 40x - 4900

⇒ 20x = 1000

⇒ x = 50

**∴ There were 50 boys in the group initially.**

questions.question: In an institute, 35% are boys and the rest are girls. If 30% of the boys failed and 60% of the girls passed in an examination, then the percentage of the students who failed in the examination is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The percentage of boys in an institute = 35%

**Formula used:**

GM\% = {GMover TM} × 100 Where, GM = Gain marks, and TM = Total marks

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of students be X

According to the question

The number of boys = {35Xover 100} = 0.35X

The number of girls = X - 0.35X = 0.65X

The number of boys who failed = 0.35X × {30over 100} = 0.105X

The number of girls who passed = 0.65X times {60over 100} = 0.39X

The number of girls who failed = 0.65X - 0.39X = 0.26X

The number of students who failed = 0.105X + 0.26X = 0.365X

The required percentage = {0.365Xover X} times 100 = 36.5\%

**∴ The required result will be 36.5%.**

The average of the remaining numbers = {2394over 50} = 47.88

questions.question: If the 8-digit number 98x423y4 is divisible by 72, then what is the value of (5x + 3y - xy), for the maximum value of y?
questions.solution:

**Concept:**

If the last three digits of a number are divisible by 8, then the number is completely divisible by 8

If sum of all the digits of the number is divisible by 9 then the number itself is divisible by 9

**Calculation:**

According to the question

The number 98x423y4 is divisible by 8 when

The last three digits = 3y4 must be divisible by 8,

∴ maximum value of y is 8 possible.

y = 8

The number is divisible by 9 when

The sum of the digits of the number = 9 + 8 + x + 4 + 2 + 3 + 8+ 4 = 38 + x 

The possible value of x = 7

The value of x = 7, and y = 8

When the number is divisible by 8, and 9 then number also divisible by 72

⇒ (5x + 3y - xy)

⇒ (5 × 7) + (3 × 8) - (7 × 8)

⇒ 35 + 24 - 56 = 59 - 56 = 3

**∴ The required result will be 3.**
